factors.label: Last Year Stats
factors.desc: Actual 2025 fantasy points in the selected scoring format

factors.label: Age
factors.desc: Player age in years. Model uses a position-specific peak-age fitness curve under the hood.

factors.label: Quarterback
factors.desc: Team QB quality among 32 NFL starters (32 = best, 1 = worst). QBs use a self quality score.

factors.label: Playcaller
factors.desc: Fantasy-friendly OC/scheme among all 32 NFL playcallers (32 = best, 1 = worst)

factors.label: ADP
factors.desc: 2026 average draft position (1.0 = first pick). Lower ADP = higher draft capital.

factors.label: Vegas Lines
factors.desc: Per-player season props: QB pass yds/TDs, RB rush+rec yds/TDs, WR/TE rec yds/TDs (NOT team wins). Higher primary line = higher market expectation.

factors.label: Opportunity
factors.desc: Projected volume/role ranked within position (1 = best opportunity at the position)

factors.label: Efficiency
factors.desc: Efficiency rating 0–100 (YPT / TD rate / explosive-play quality)

factors.label: Health
factors.desc: Estimated games played durability (0–17). Higher = healthier profile.

factors.label: Strength of Schedule
factors.desc: Schedule ease among 32 teams (32 = easiest fantasy schedule, 1 = hardest)

model_notes: Display values use natural units. The Summary total is a weighted average of 0–100 percentiles of each factor (so FPts, ADP, win totals, etc. can combine).
sources: 2026 Vegas win totals (DraftKings via FOX Sports, Jul 2026)
Playcaller/QB ranks: model composite for 2026 staffs (1–32 among 32 teams)
